text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened on the day I went out with the landlady.
By chance, we ran into an old acquaintance of hers……

text_block_list.name: Landlady's Old Friend
text_block_list.text:
Phew, it was good talking to you after so long.
...Well then, I'll be taking my leave shortly to have a quick smoke.

text_block_list.name: Landlady's Old Friend
text_block_list.text: ...Hoshina-san actually managed to quit smoking. Man, gotta give her credit. I really should follow her lead.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...A very long time ago, yes.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
What is it?
You're not hiding your curiosity very well.
choice_data_list: It's just rare to hear you ask about the past, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since we met, but I still barely know her.
There was no way my curiosity wouldn't be piqued.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Haha, give me a break! I haven't walked
nearly as noble a path as you seem to think!
choice_data_list: Still, they're a wonderful person now!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so?
Is that how it looks to you?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Looking at me like that makes me feel like I'm lying, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you're curious, maybe I'll tell you about it.
Stories from my greener days, that is.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
――……Back when I was still a trainer at the Academy.
And a rookie just starting out at that.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Well... things were pretty hectic.
I ended up puffing on them year-round, almost like I was trying to distract myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*click*, *fwoosh*)

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Here's the data on the runners for the next race...
Ugh, another lineup that's going to take forever to analyze.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
If I work through tonight, I'll be done by morning...
and I can hand over the menu before training starts... Then—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There you were, in the smoking area!
Your trainee!
She was just rushed to the hospital!

text_block_list.name: Hoshina's Trainee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...
I was doing some self-training, and suddenly... my leg...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Stop that.
You did nothing wrong.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina's Trainee Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, but... the doctor said... running like I used to is... no longer...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...They might have said it's difficult, but they never said it's impossible!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: So don't worry... I'll handle it somehow, so stop crying.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*click*, *fwoosh*)

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Refreshing in nature, changing horseshoes...
*cough*, isn't there any other kind of recuperation...?!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer Hoshina... wait, smoking again?
Lately, hasn't your daily count... gone up?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Don't mind me. It's just a little habit of mine when I'm thinking.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Still, you look terribly pale...！？

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's nothing you need to worry about.
Seriously, just... leave me... *ugh*――

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Trainer Hoshina?!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...It's overwork.
I strongly advise taking some rest.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you been smoking more lately?
If you abruptly increase how much you smoke, of course your health is going to suffer.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please take this opportunity to cut back.
Go to a hot spring or somewhere different,
and force yourself to rest. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Pathetic…… but a hot spring, huh?
Yeah, maybe I should take that kid along once in a while……

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it. It's been used in human therapy for ages, so maybe...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Any recorded cases of testing on Umamusume? Medical treatment history?
What about spring mineral composition, effective bathing methods, and――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*click, fwoosh*)

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Idiot. How long do you plan on keeping up that habit?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...How can someone who can't even protect their own health protect an Umamusume's?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Squish)

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Well, turned out for the best in the end.
Now that I'm running this rest house, that is.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I did. So very much.
...Yet, what choice do I have but to change?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Hardly anyone starts out great. Everyone messes up somehow. But... you can always change.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...They're surprisingly important. Dreams, goals, and the like.
They give you a reason to change yourself.
choice_data_list: Changing yourself for your dreams is really admirable.
Still, putting it into practice is the hard part, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Man, cut it out!
That's not what I wanted you to say.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Man, I ended up rambling on and on.
I didn't even want to look back on such naive memories.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Did you get inspired seeing a certain someone working so hard?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But hey, it's always easier done than said.
When the time comes, things'll probably just sort themselves out.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Man, I really rambled on, huh?
And here I thought I never wanted to look back on those naive, immature memories.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Did you get inspired seeing a certain someone working so hard?
